note_curves: entry 99: the thirteen killing quartics are five curves up to isomorphism (Cremona labels), all with full 2-torsion, rank 0, conductor 2^k x {1,3,5,7}: 32a2 (j = 1728, CM by Z[i], the Fermat/congruent-number curve), 48a1, 48a3, 56a2, 80a1 -- each model a twist/quotient of one of these.

towers.note: entry 100: quotient towers on the finite classes (compute/omega3_towers.py). Every finite model is even (t -> -t, the conjugate frame); the quotients u = t^2, w = t + kappa/t (twisted reciprocity), the odd companion Y^2 = x Q(x) of an even quotient polynomial, and their iterates give elliptic curves; a rank-0 quotient with a complete point enumeration lifts to finitely many t, and if none is a non-degenerate frame ratio the class is DEAD. Height searches (H = 2000) on the remaining models are evidence only.

genus_bounds.note: entry 102: a rigorous lower bound on the geometric genus of every high-bidegree component (compute/omega3_genus.py): Riemann-Hurwitz for a coordinate projection with the ramification over each branch value bounded below by the fiber degree minus the sum of the point multiplicities (a point of multiplicity m carries at most m branches), computed exactly over the number fields of the branch values (PARI; discriminant factors up to degree 40), plus an absolute-irreducibility certificate (irreducible mod p with a smooth F_p-point). g_lb >= 2 with the certificate makes the component Faltings-finite. The local sieve (compute/omega3_sieve.py) was tried first and is vacuous.
genus_bounds.correction: entry 103: the entry-102 bounds were computed with PARI's factor over a NON-MONIC modulus, which silently changes the generator of the branch-value field; 204 of the component bounds were wrong in value (182 too low, 22 too high), none crossed the threshold downward, so the 1224 certifications stood; recomputed with the fiber factored by nffactor against nfinit of the monic integral polynomial of the scaled root (compute/omega3_genus.py, monicfield). Corrected count: 1264 of the 1267 certified; the 3 not certified are the degenerate classes (no high-bidegree component at all), killed by the common-factor rule. Superseded by the exact genera of the resolution block.

resolution.note: entry 103: THE EXACT GENUS of every high-bidegree component by resolution of singularities (compute/omega3_resolve.py): g = p_a - sum_Q delta_Q with delta_Q = sum m_P(m_P - 1)/2 over the infinitely near points of the blow-up tree (directions in extension fields handled by PARI rnfequation, every field monic integral, factored by nffactor), the branch count r_Q = the number of smooth terminal points; cross-checked against Riemann-Hurwitz for the t-projection with the exact ramification R = R_lb + sum_Q (m_Q - r_Q) (2g must equal 2 - 2 dh + R), and the absolute-irreducibility certificate. A class is finite when, in some frame, every component is dead or has exact genus >= 2 (certified, consistent).

common_factors.note: entry 103: 48 classes have a non-constant common factor G of the two relations (R1 = R2 = 0 iff G = 0 or the reduced pair vanishes); every irreducible factor met is a monomial (degenerate frame), a norm c^2 + s^2 (never zero) or a same-prime factor t_g = +-t_h, t_g t_h = +-1 (the (2,+-2) monomial relation, dead by the monomial lemma). 45 of the 48 were already dead; the 3 whose G depends on every frame (every resultant vanished: the 'degenerate' classes of entry 97) are now DEAD (compute.omega3.reduced_relations, classify_common_factor).

base_locus.note: entry 104: the base locus of the elimination in the certifying frame of every finite class (compute/omega3_finiteness.py): the pairs (t_g, t_h) at which every coefficient of both relations (as polynomials in s_f) vanishes, so that the relations hold for every third frame. A zero-dimensional system per class, solved exactly (lex Groebner basis; rational roots). An ADMISSIBLE base point (both coordinates non-degenerate Pythagorean frame ratios) would give a square for every third prime; none exists. With every class dead or finite (entry 103) this gives the FINITENESS STATEMENT: up to the scaling by the inert cofactor, only finitely many 3x3 magic squares of squares have a center whose split part is a product of three distinct first-power primes -- ineffective (Faltings), resting on the engine's verdicts. Entry 117: 8 classes whose tower kill was void (the twist audit) reverted to finite and received their base-locus records (zero-dimensional, no rational point): the statement stands.

minor_formula.note: entry 105: in the frame f to eliminate every element is linear in (X, Y, N) = (2 c_f s_f, c_f^2 - s_f^2, c_f^2 + s_f^2), X^2 + Y^2 = N^2, so R1 = a1 X + b1 Y + c1 N, R2 = a2 X + b2 Y + c2 N with a_i, b_i, c_i forms of bidegree <= (2,2) in the other frames, and Res_{s_f}(R1, R2) = 4 (D_X^2 + D_Y^2 - D_N^2) with (D_X, D_Y, D_N) the cross product of the rows (the classical resultant of two binary quadratics): every quadruple curve is a component of the pullback of the circle under the minor map m = (D_X : D_Y : D_N) of bidegree <= (4,4). Claim 1 (every component divides D_X^2 + D_Y^2 - D_N^2) holds for all 1264 certified classes. Claim 2: singular points of the certified component that are base points of m (all three minors vanish at the point, tested exactly over the branch-value field, affine chart): 878 classes have every affine singular point on the base locus; the others' exceptions lie only over t^2 + 1 (334), t (62), t +- 1 (8), t^2 +- 2t - 1 (4): the circle's branch points and torsion values -- the tangency points of the minor map with the circle. Third frame at a point of Phi_f: (X : Y : N) = (D_X : D_Y : D_N), t_f = D_X / (D_N + D_Y), Pythagorean condition 2 D_N (D_N + D_Y) = square.

dichotomy.note: entry 109: THE SINGULAR-LOCUS DICHOTOMY (theorem, doc 2.39): with the eliminated frame at exponent 1 the relations are quadratics q_i in w_f; a singular point of a component is a base point of the minor map (q_1, q_2 proportional), the projection of a singular point of the space curve Gamma = {R1 = R2 = 0}, or on the toric boundary (a frame at +-i). Every exception of the entry-105 census re-examined exactly over the branch fields: the rows at the singular point are rank 0 (both relations vanish identically in t_f), rank 1 (proportional, or one relation zero) -- base points after all, missed by the non-squarefree test -- or, over t = +-i only, points where the common root is at t_f = +-i or a quadratic drops degree (the toric boundary in the eliminated frame too).

quotients.note: entry 105 (attempt B, step 1): every certified component is invariant under the joint sign change (t_g, t_h) -> (-t_g, -t_h) and 944 carry a further involution on one coordinate (t -> -t, 1/t, -1/t) or the swap. compute/omega3_quotients.py forms the quotient by each single-coordinate involution (the squarefree image of the resultant against the invariant's relation) and by the joint sign change (invariants t_g^2, t_g t_h), computes its exact genus (resolution tool), and for a genus-1 quotient quadratic in a variable runs the rank-0 route with a complete lift: every rational point of the quotient (PARI ellrank + complete enumeration, square-part roots added) is lifted to the finitely many rational preimages; if none is a pair of non-degenerate Pythagorean frame ratios, the class is DEAD. Genus-0 quotients give nothing; genus >= 2 quotients are recorded.

two_step.note: entry 106: the joint quotient E = Phi/sigma of genus 1 (80 still-finite classes) has no model quadratic in a variable ((x, z) = (t_g^2, t_h^2) and (x, y) = (t_g^2, t_g t_h) models both of bidegree up to (4,4)); a SECOND involution of the curve descends to E, and W = E/tau (coordinate_quotient with kind 'rec' on the (x, z) model; the joint reciprocity through (x + 1/x, z + 1/z); the swap through (x + z, xz)) has lower degree. W of genus 1 and quadratic in a variable: the rank-0 route lists its points, each has finitely many preimages on E (a quadratic) and on the curve (x, z rational squares). W of genus 0: parametrized (conic route), E is the double cover y^2 = Delta(lambda) (Delta = v^2 - 4 or s^2 - 4p), its own genus-1 quartic: rank 0, the parameter values, the exact lift. Also fixed: quartic_points counted no point at infinity for CUBIC models (which always have one), so rank-0 cubics were never 'complete'; no earlier kill depended on a cubic.

killers.note: entry 112: every rank-0 model on record identified in PARI (ellfromeqn, ellidentify, analytic rank): (A) the coordinate/joint quotient models -- entry 105's and the (2,1,1) sweep's rank0_models, 31 quartics y^2 = q(x) -- are ELEVEN curves up to isomorphism, not the ten of entries 100/107: 120b2 (models (1, 0, 1, 0, 4), (4, 0, 1, 0, 1); 16 kills in entry 105) was missing. All eleven have full rational 2-torsion, so each is a Legendre curve y^2 = x(x-1)(x-lambda); the S_3-orbit and its largest element are recorded, one value per curve. Every even model y^2 = a x^4 + b x^2 + c has ac a square and lambda = (b - 2 sqrt(ac))/(b + 2 sqrt(ac)) (checked). (B) the two-step route of entry 106 (W = E/tau models, cubics and quartics) killed through FOUR MORE curves: 30a1 and 240b1 (no full rational 2-torsion), 30a2 and 240b2 (twists of each other, lambda = 32/5). A first computation took the constant term of non-monic factors as a root (15a3 came out with lambda = 3); fixed: roots = -F[k,1](0) / lc, and 15a3 has lambda = 16 like its twist 240d2. Fifteen curves across all routes. The branch points of the (A) models in the torus coordinate w = (1 + i t)/(1 - i t): torsion, hyperbolic (real w), on the circle but not torsion, or generic -- no uniform pattern. Rank 0 is verified, not explained.

genus0.note: entry 115 (R.10 objective O2, first step, with Sage 10.7 in WSL): the 24 finite classes whose component (bidegree (6,8), (8,6) or (6,6), genus 5) has a genus-0 quotient W by t -> -1/t on one coordinate. Sage parametrizes every W over Q (u(t), v(t)); with u = N/M the points of the component over rational points of W are the rational points of the hyperelliptic curve H: y^2 = D(t) = N^2 + 4 M^2 (tg = (N +- y)/(2M), th = v(t)); H has genus 5, and its rational points off the exceptional set (t = infinity, M = 0, the rational singular points of W -- all degenerate) are exactly the rational points of the component. In 22 classes D is even in t, so s = t^2 gives a genus-2 quotient y^2 = Dt(s) = C_1(s) C_2(s), a product of two cubics; the other two have a Klein four-group of Mobius involutions and become even after tau = t/(t - p). Up to Q-isomorphism there are exactly two genus-2 curves: C1: y^2 = (s^3 - 5s^2 + 11s + 1)(s^3 + 11s^2 - 5s + 1) with the involution s -> 1/s (8 classes, after the rescalings s -> s/4, s -> s/78400 and the tau change), whose elliptic quotient E+ = Q(w)(w + 2), Q = w^3 + 6w^2 - 52w + 136, is 11a3 (rank 0, five torsion points, all listed): the rational points of C1 lie over s in {0, 1, -1, infinity}, the lifts are degenerate -- EIGHT CLASSES DEAD; and C2: y^2 = (25*s**3 - 61*s**2 + 43*s + 1)*(25*s**3 - 29*s**2 + 11*s + 1) (16 classes: Dt = mu C2(lambda s) or mu s^6 C2(lambda/s), mu a square, lambda in {1, 56644, 42025/1849}), discriminant 2^62 5^4 23 83, at least 14 rational points (s in {-3, 0, 1, 1/3, -1/5, 3/5} and two at infinity), no Mobius involution of its six roots, Frobenius polynomials irreducible over Q at 13, 17, 19, 29, 31, 41, 43, 47, 53 (a presumably simple Jacobian with End = Z): the known points lift to no rational point of any of the sixteen components, but C2(Q) is not known to be complete -- a RankBound / Chabauty computation in Magma (compute/magma/genus0_quotients_C2.m) is the missing step; with rank >= 2 and End = Z even quadratic Chabauty would not apply.

base_locus_minor_map.note: entry 110: the affine base locus {D_X = D_Y = D_N = 0} of the minor map of every certified class, exactly (compute/omega3_minors.py: base_locus_points): the common factor of the three minors (curves), the full lines t = c of the residual locus, and its isolated points after saturation by the line equations (lex Groebner bases over Q), with every coordinate classified. THEOREM (doc 2.40): in the torus coordinate w_f the relations are quadratics alpha w^2 + beta w + gamma with gamma the conjugate of alpha up to a monomial, so the base locus is the common zero set of alpha_1 gamma_2 - alpha_2 gamma_1 and alpha_1 beta_2 - alpha_2 beta_1, two Laurent polynomials in (w_g, w_h) with at most nine monomials; when both alphas are monomials (262 of 1264 pairs) the first is the torsion coset W_1/W_2 = +-1 and the second a one-variable equation of degree <= 4 along it. On the box: the curves are the same-prime cosets w_g = +-w_h^{+-1} (t_g = +-t_h, t_g t_h = +-1) and, for the 18 classes whose relations both involve frame f in all three elements (beta_1 = beta_2 = 0, so Res = (alpha_1 gamma_2 - alpha_2 gamma_1)^2), the quadruple curve itself -- a (4,4) curve of genus 7 or 9 along which the minors give no third frame; the lines are degenerate or boundary lines; no coordinate of an isolated point or a line is a frame ratio. Hence outside the 18 self-base classes no base point is an admissible frame pair; on those 18 the statement is the class's own finiteness certificate.

extension_low_bidegree.note: entry 111: the minor-map base locus of the 304 finite classes with a single low-bidegree component (no resolution block; not covered by the entry-110 census): 200 are self-base (the trinomial-type classes: the quadruple curve is its own base locus), no coordinate of a point or line is a frame ratio; a new coordinate kind, degree-6 values, appears.

elimination_theorem.note: entry 111: THE ELIMINATION BASE-LOCUS THEOREM (doc 2.41). The coefficient of w_f^j of a relation, as a Laurent polynomial in the eliminated frame, has #{l_e = j} + #{l_e = -j} terms (2 #{l_e = 0} for j = 0), each a signed monomial in (w_g, w_h). A monomial never vanishes on the torus; a binomial vanishes on a torsion coset w_g^a w_h^b = +-1; unique factorization in Z[i] puts no pair of frame ratios of distinct split primes on a proper torsion coset and no frame ratio at a torsion point. Hence the elimination base locus is empty (some relation empty-type: a coefficient is a monomial), on torsion cosets (torsion-type relations: every coefficient a binomial), or -- only when the eliminated frame has the same absolute exponent in all four labels -- the intersection of two trinomial curves; the base-locus condition of every finiteness statement is automatic except in that last case. Tested on the (1,1,1) box: compute/omega3_finiteness.elimination_type (the prediction from the labels) against elimination_locus (the exact affine locus, coordinates classified) for the 1568 classes finite at entry 104.

free_frame.note: entry 116: the free-frame reduction (compute/omega3_freeframe.py) applied to the 444 classes of the box in which a frame appears in exactly one label. Kills: T = the ladder theorem for the two-frame shape (the relation not containing the free element is a signed three-term relation of the two-frame box: A3.7 here), E = an elliptic frame-condition curve of rank 0 whose torsion points give no liftable admissible pair, B = a torsion-coset factor (Lemma B), Z = a degenerate-only reduced relation. Every one of the 444 was already dead by the engine (entries 97-106): the reduction re-derives the death of 354 of them uniformly.

twist_audit.note: entry 117 (the review of 2026-09-06, finding 1): compute/omega3._disc_model dropped the constant of the discriminant's factorization and gp_model divided a model's coefficients by their gcd; a non-square constant is a quadratic twist, so a rank-0 / point-count verdict could belong to the wrong curve (the reviewer's control: the curve 8425 th^2 - 11664 (tg^4 + 1) has the admissible point (4/3, 12/5) and was declared dead). The same pattern was in compute/omega3_towers.int_coeffs (denominators cleared with the lcm, the gcd divided out).
